name: Anki Sync Server
description: A self-hosted Anki sync server that allows syncing flashcards across devices without relying on AnkiWeb.

notes.text: Credentials are stored in /opt/anki-sync-server/.env (SYNC_USER1=username:password). Add more users with SYNC_USER2, SYNC_USER3, etc.
Configure Anki clients: Tools > Preferences > Syncing > Self-hosted sync server, enter http://<IP>:8080/
